endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: va_city_radford_dwr_bisset_park_dudleys_landing_20260919 city-radford-bisset-park-dudleys-landing-ramp: Virginia DWR identifies the Bisset Park Boat Ramp, also called Dudley's Landing, as a New River launch/take-out on river right below the Route 11 bridge. The City of Radford confirms Dudley's Landing and Bisset Park boat-launch access, while the New River Valley Regional Commission documents the public Bisset Park Shelter #3 boat-access facility and parking/path project. The stored point is retained as a park/ramp access-area anchor; the 437-foot named-flowline offset is a facility-placement warning, not evidence that the named public ramp is wrong.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (va_city_radford_dwr_bisset_park_dudleys_landing_20260919 city-radford-bisset-park-dudleys-landing-ramp) on New River; access is conditional (Confirm current City of Radford ramp, parking, and carry conditions at arrival; use the marked public facility and do not assume every park shoreline point is a launch.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
